name: set_volume
description: Change the Mac's output volume: mute, unmute, louder, quieter, or max.

args.name: level
args.instructions: How does the user want the system volume changed?

script:
set lvl to "{{level}}"
if lvl is "mute" then
  set volume with output muted
else if lvl is "unmute" then
  set volume without output muted
else if lvl is "max" then
  set volume output volume 100 without output muted
else
  set cur to output volume of (get volume settings)
  if lvl is "louder" then
    set volume output volume (cur + 15) without output muted
  else
    set volume output volume (cur - 15)
  end if
end if
return "volume " & (output volume of (get volume settings))

name: open_app
description: Open, launch, or switch to an application and bring its window to the front (Chrome opens a new window in your work profile).

args.name: app
args.instructions: Which application does the user want opened or brought to the front?

script:
if "{{app}}" is "Google Chrome" then
  set homeArg to ""
  if "{{chrome_home}}" is not "" then set homeArg to " " & quoted form of "{{chrome_home}}"
  do shell script "open -na 'Google Chrome' --args " & quoted form of ("--profile-directory=" & "{{chrome_profile}}") & " --new-window" & homeArg
else
  tell application "{{app}}" to activate
end if
repeat 15 times
  delay 0.2
  tell application "System Events" to set frontName to name of first application process whose frontmost is true
  if frontName is "{{app}}" then exit repeat
  try
    tell application "System Events" to set frontmost of process "{{app}}" to true
  end try
end repeat
try
  tell application "{{app}}"
    if (count of windows) = 0 then reopen
  end tell
end try
if frontName is "{{app}}" then return "{{app}} is in front"
return "{{app}} launched, but " & frontName & " is still in front"
not_for: Websites, URLs, web searches, or anything the user says to do 'in the browser' or 'from the browser'; those belong to a browser tool (safari_open / chrome_open).

name: quit_app
description: Quit a running application.

args.name: app
args.instructions: Which running application does the user want to quit?

script:
tell application "{{app}}" to quit
return "{{app}} closed"

name: hide_others
description: Hide every application except the one in front.
script:
tell application "System Events" to set visible of every application process whose frontmost is false and background only is false to false
return "hid other apps"

name: search_here
description: Search for something inside the app or website the user is on right now: the site open in the browser tab (YouTube, Amazon, GitHub... in the same tab) or the front app's own search (Spotify, Notes, Mail, Finder, a web app...).

args.name: query
args.instructions: What to search for, without command words like 'search for' or 'look up'.

script:
set q to "{{query}}"
set u to "{{search_url}}"
tell application "System Events" to set frontApp to name of first application process whose frontmost is true
if frontApp is "Google Chrome" then
  tell application "Google Chrome" to set URL of active tab of front window to u
  return "Searching for " & q & "."
else if frontApp is "Safari" then
  tell application "Safari" to set URL of current tab of front window to u
  return "Searching for " & q & "."
end if
-- Any other app: its own search shortcut. Return is pressed only where it runs a search,
-- so an unknown app never gets a stray Enter (it could send a message).
set k to "f"
set mods to {command down}
set pressReturn to false
if frontApp is "Spotify" then
  set k to "l"
  set pressReturn to true
else if frontApp is in {"Notes", "Mail"} then
  set mods to {command down, option down}
  set pressReturn to true
else if frontApp is in {"Music", "Finder", "Podcasts", "TV", "Books", "App Store"} then
  set pressReturn to true
else if frontApp is "Slack" then
  set k to "g"
  set pressReturn to true
else if frontApp is "Web App" then
  set k to "/"
  set mods to {}
  set pressReturn to true
end if
tell application "System Events"
  if mods is {} then
    keystroke k
  else
    keystroke k using mods
  end if
  delay 0.4
  keystroke q
  if pressReturn then
    delay 0.2
    key code 36
  end if
end tell
return "Searching " & frontApp & " for " & q & "."
not_for: A search on a site or app the user names that is not the one open (chrome_open / open_app first), or playing a specific video right away (youtube_play).

name: open_result
description: Open or play result number N (the first, second, third...) listed on the web page in front in Chrome or Safari, in the same tab: a video in YouTube results, a search result, a product in a list.

args.name: position
args.instructions: Which result on the page does the user mean?

script:
set n to "{{position}}"
set u to "{{result_url}}"
set js to "{{result_js}}"
set listing to "{{listing}}"
tell application "System Events" to set frontApp to name of first application process whose frontmost is true
if frontApp is "Google Chrome" then
  if u is "" and listing is not "" then
    -- "the second one" after opening the first: go back to the results list it refers to
    tell application "Google Chrome"
      if (URL of active tab of front window) is not listing then
        set URL of active tab of front window to listing
        delay 2.5
      end if
    end tell
  end if
  if u is "" then
    try
      tell application "Google Chrome" to set u to (execute active tab of front window javascript js)
    on error
      error "I can't read this page yet. In Chrome, turn on View, Developer, Allow JavaScript from Apple Events."
    end try
    if u is missing value then set u to ""
  end if
  if u is "" then error "I couldn't find result " & n & " on this page."
  tell application "Google Chrome" to set URL of active tab of front window to u
  delay 2
  tell application "Google Chrome" to return title of active tab of front window
else if frontApp is "Safari" then
  if u is "" and listing is not "" then
    -- "the second one" after opening the first: go back to the results list it refers to
    tell application "Safari"
      if (URL of current tab of front window) is not listing then
        set URL of current tab of front window to listing
        delay 2.5
      end if
    end tell
  end if
  if u is "" then
    try
      tell application "Safari" to set u to (do JavaScript js in current tab of front window)
    on error
      error "I can't read this page yet. In Safari, turn on Develop, Allow JavaScript from Apple Events."
    end try
    if u is missing value then set u to ""
  end if
  if u is "" then error "I couldn't find result " & n & " on this page."
  tell application "Safari" to set URL of current tab of front window to u
  delay 2
  tell application "Safari" to return name of current tab of front window
end if
error "Opening a result works on a page in Chrome or Safari."
examples: play the first video on the current page
not_for: Pausing or resuming a video that is already open (app_action play_pause); searching (search_here).

name: type_here
description: Type dictated text wherever the cursor is in the front app (a text box, search field, document), without pressing Enter.

args.name: text
args.instructions: The exact words to type, without command words like 'type' or 'write'.

script:
set t to "{{text}}"
tell application "System Events" to keystroke t
return "typed"
examples: type in see you at five
write thanks for the update here
not_for: Writing into a note in Apple Notes (notes_write); searching (search_here).

name: app_action
description: Do a common action in the app or page in front: play/pause, next or previous video or song, go back or forward, reload, new item, new or close or switch tab, undo, redo, find, save, zoom, scroll, jump to top or bottom.

args.name: action
args.instructions: Which action in the front app does the user want?

criteria.play_pause: Play or pause the video or music that is already open in the front app or page (not opening one from a list)
criteria.next_media: Skip to the next video, song or episode in the front app or page
criteria.previous_media: Go to the previous video, song or episode in the front app or page
criteria.back: Go back to the previous page/screen
criteria.close_tab: Close the current tab or window

script:
set a to "{{action}}"
tell application "System Events" to set frontApp to name of first application process whose frontmost is true
set onYouTube to (frontApp is "Web App" or frontApp is "Google Chrome" or frontApp is "Safari") and ("{{focus_name}}{{focus_id}}" contains "youtube")
set focusUrl to "{{focus_id}}"
if onYouTube and focusUrl starts with "http" and focusUrl does not contain "/watch" and focusUrl does not contain "/shorts/" then
  if a is "play_pause" or a is "next_media" or a is "previous_media" then
    error "No video is open on this page. Say play the first video to start one."
  end if
end if
if a is "play_pause" then
  -- YouTube's own shortcut is k; media players use space. Anywhere else space would type into a
  -- text field, so say so instead of pressing it.
  if onYouTube then
    tell application "System Events" to keystroke "k"
  else if frontApp is in {"Spotify", "Music", "Podcasts", "TV", "QuickTime Player", "VLC", "IINA", "Books"} then
    tell application "System Events" to key code 49
  else
    error "There is nothing to play or pause in " & frontApp & "."
  end if
  return a
end if
if a is "next_media" or a is "previous_media" then
  tell application "System Events"
    if onYouTube and a is "next_media" then
      keystroke "n" using {shift down}
    else if onYouTube then
      keystroke "[" using {command down}
    else if frontApp is in {"Spotify", "Music", "Podcasts", "TV"} then
      if a is "next_media" then
        key code 124 using {command down}
      else
        key code 123 using {command down}
      end if
    else
      error "There is nothing to skip in " & frontApp & "."
    end if
  end tell
  return a
end if
tell application "System Events"
  if a is "back" then
    keystroke "[" using {command down}
  else if a is "forward" then
    keystroke "]" using {command down}
  else if a is "reload" then
    keystroke "r" using {command down}
  else if a is "new_item" then
    keystroke "n" using {command down}
  else if a is "new_tab" then
    keystroke "t" using {command down}
  else if a is "close_tab" then
    keystroke "w" using {command down}
  else if a is "next_tab" then
    key code 48 using {control down}
  else if a is "previous_tab" then
    key code 48 using {control down, shift down}
  else if a is "undo" then
    keystroke "z" using {command down}
  else if a is "redo" then
    keystroke "z" using {command down, shift down}
  else if a is "find" then
    keystroke "f" using {command down}
  else if a is "save" then
    keystroke "s" using {command down}
  else if a is "zoom_in" then
    keystroke "=" using {command down}
  else if a is "zoom_out" then
    keystroke "-" using {command down}
  else if a is "scroll_down" then
    key code 121
  else if a is "scroll_up" then
    key code 116
  else if a is "top" then
    key code 115
  else if a is "bottom" then
    key code 119
  end if
end tell
return a
not_for: Quitting an app (quit_app); anything in an app that is not in front; opening or playing an item from a list of results (open_result).

name: ui_press
description: Open, select, press or play something by its name inside the app in front, using the app's real on-screen controls: a song or item shown in a list (play Butter), a sidebar or library item, playlist, section, tab, button or menu command (Liked Songs in Spotify, Inbox in Mail, Settings, New Playlist). Also 'play it' / 'play that one' right after talking about an item that is on screen.
not_for: Web pages in Chrome or Safari (search_here, open_result, web_task); opening another app (open_app); typing text (type_here); resuming or pausing whatever is already playing (app_action play_pause / spotify_play_pause).

name: read_screen
description: Answer a question about what is visible in the app or page in front right now: which songs, items, messages, results or buttons are showing, whether something is on screen, what a list or page contains.
examples: can you see a butter song on this page
which playlists do I have here
not_for: What is playing right now (spotify_now_playing / music_now_playing); the URL of the page (chrome_get_url).

name: take_screenshot
description: Capture the whole screen to a timestamped PNG on the Desktop.
script:
set ts to do shell script "date +%Y-%m-%d_%H.%M.%S"
set p to (POSIX path of (path to desktop)) & "Screenshot_" & ts & ".png"
do shell script "screencapture -x " & quoted form of p
return "saved to Desktop"

script:

return "locked"

script:

  if (count of windows) = 0 then return "no Safari window is open"

examples: what's the url of this page

name: safari_open
description: Open a well-known site (YouTube, Gmail, Google Calendar, GitHub...), a URL, or a web search in a new Safari tab.

args.name: site
args.instructions: If the user named a well-known website, which one? Otherwise choose other.

criteria.other: Not a well-known site name; treat the query as a URL or web search

args.name: query
args.instructions: What to open: the site name, a URL, or the search phrase (for 'search YouTube for X', just X).

script:
set site to "{{site}}"
set q to "{{query}}"
-- a phrase beyond the site name itself means: search within that site
set siteWord to site
set AppleScript's text item delimiters to "_"
set siteWord to (text items of site) as text
set AppleScript's text item delimiters to " "
set enc to (text items of q) as text
set AppleScript's text item delimiters to "+"
set enc to (text items of enc) as text
set AppleScript's text item delimiters to ""
set hasPhrase to (q is not "") and (q does not contain siteWord)
if site is "other" then
  if q contains "." and q does not contain " " then
    if q does not start with "http" then set q to "https://" & q
  else
    set q to "https://www.google.com/search?q=" & enc
  end if
  else if site is "youtube" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://www.youtube.com"
    end if
  else if site is "gmail" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://mail.google.com/mail/#search/" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://mail.google.com"
    end if
  else if site is "google_calendar" then
    set q to "https://calendar.google.com"
  else if site is "google_drive" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://drive.google.com/drive/search?q=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://drive.google.com"
    end if
  else if site is "google_docs" then
    set q to "https://docs.google.com"
  else if site is "google_maps" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://www.google.com/maps/search/" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://maps.google.com"
    end if
  else if site is "github" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://github.com/search?q=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://github.com"
    end if
  else if site is "x_twitter" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://x.com/search?q=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://x.com"
    end if
  else if site is "linkedin" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/all/?keywords=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://www.linkedin.com"
    end if
  else if site is "notion" then
    set q to "https://www.notion.so"
  else if site is "slack_web" then
    set q to "https://app.slack.com"
  else if site is "figma" then
    set q to "https://www.figma.com"
  else if site is "chatgpt" then
    set q to "https://chatgpt.com"
  else if site is "claude" then
    set q to "https://claude.ai"
  else if site is "reddit" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://www.reddit.com/search/?q=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://www.reddit.com"
    end if
  else if site is "wikipedia" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://www.wikipedia.org"
    end if
  else if site is "amazon" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://www.amazon.com/s?k=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://www.amazon.com"
    end if
  else if site is "netflix" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://www.netflix.com/search?q=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://www.netflix.com"
    end if
  else if site is "spotify_web" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://open.spotify.com/search/" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://open.spotify.com"
    end if
  else if site is "hacker_news" then
    set q to "https://news.ycombinator.com"
  else if site is "stack_overflow" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://stackoverflow.com/search?q=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://stackoverflow.com"
    end if
  else if site is "hugging_face" then
    if hasPhrase then
      set q to "https://huggingface.co/search/full-text?q=" & enc
    else
      set q to "https://huggingface.co"
    end if
  else if site is "linear" then
    set q to "https://linear.app"
  else if site is "vercel" then
    set q to "https://vercel.com"
  else if site is "livekit" then
    set q to "https://docs.livekit.io"
  else if site is "gradium" then
    set q to "https://gradium.ai"
  else if site is "typesafe" then
    set q to "https://typesafe.ai"
  else if site is "outlook" then
    set q to "https://outlook.live.com"
  else if site is "whatsapp_web" then
    set q to "https://web.whatsapp.com"
end if
tell application "Safari"
  activate
  if (count of windows) = 0 then make new window
  tell front window to set current tab to (make new tab with properties {URL:q})
end tell
return q
examples: go to my google calendar from the browser
search youtube for the love hypothesis
not_for: 'search for X' while another app is in front and no website or web search is named (search_here searches inside that app).

name: safari_new_tab
description: Open a blank new tab in Safari.
script:
tell application "Safari"
  if (count of windows) = 0 then return "no Safari window is open"
end tell
tell application "Safari"
  activate
  tell front window to set current tab to (make new tab)
end tell
return "new tab"

script:
tell application "Safari"
  if (count of windows) = 0 then return "no Safari window is open"
end tell
tell application "Safari" to close current tab of front window
return "closed tab"

name: safari_close_all_tabs

script:

  if (count of windows) = 0 then return "no window open"
  set n to count of tabs of front window

  return "closed " & n & " tabs"
end tell

script:
tell application "Safari"
  if (count of windows) = 0 then return "no Safari window is open"
end tell
tell application "Safari" to tell front document to set URL to (get URL)
return "reloaded"

name: safari_back

script:
tell application "Safari"
  if (count of windows) = 0 then return "no Safari window is open"
end tell
tell application "Safari" to do JavaScript "history.back()" in current tab of front window
return "back"

repeat 15 times

name: youtube_play

      if (URL of active tab of front window) contains "youtube.com" then
        set URL of active tab of front window to vurl
        return "playing"
      end if
    end if
  end tell
end if

name: web_task
description: Carry out a multi-step task inside a website in Chrome: search on a site and pick a result, add something to a cart or list, fill in a form, draft an email, find and read a specific thing on a page.

args.name: site
args.instructions: Which website should the task start on? Keep to the page that is open (current_tab) unless the user names a different site.

criteria.current_tab: The web page already open in the front Chrome tab (`open_in_frontmost_app`): the default whenever the user names no other website
criteria.google: Google search or an unspecified site (non-shopping)
criteria.google_flights: Google Flights: searching or comparing flights, airfares, travel dates
criteria.google_shopping: Shopping for a product or comparing prices across stores when no specific retailer is named

examples: go to amazon and search for the best vacuum cleaner and add it to my cart
on gmail draft an email to alex saying the demo is at 3
find me cheap flights from paris to tokyo in october
open linkedin and accept my pending connection requests
not_for: Just opening a site or a plain search (chrome_open); playing a YouTube video (youtube_play); managing tabs or windows: closing, switching, reloading, going back (chrome_* / safari_* tools); the URL of the current tab (chrome_get_url); writing into a note (notes_* tools).

name: chrome_close_tab
description: Close the current Google Chrome tab.
script:
tell application "Google Chrome"
  if (count of windows) = 0 then return "no Chrome window is open"
end tell
tell application "Google Chrome" to close active tab of front window
return "closed tab"
not_for: Closing all tabs or the whole window (chrome_close_all_tabs).

name: chrome_close_all_tabs
description: Close every tab in the front Google Chrome window (the whole window closes).
script:
tell application "Google Chrome"
  if (count of windows) = 0 then return "no window open"
  set n to count of tabs of front window
  close front window
  return "closed " & n & " tabs"
end tell
examples: close all the tabs in this window
not_for: Closing just the current tab (chrome_close_tab) or quitting Chrome (quit_app).

name: chrome_reload
description: Reload the current Google Chrome page.
script:
tell application "Google Chrome"
  if (count of windows) = 0 then return "no Chrome window is open"
end tell
tell application "Google Chrome" to reload active tab of front window
return "reloaded"

name: finder_open_folder
description: Open a common folder in a new Finder window.

args.name: folder
args.instructions: Which folder does the user want to open?

script:
set f to "{{folder}}"
if f is "desktop" then
  set p to path to desktop
else if f is "downloads" then
  set p to path to downloads folder
else if f is "documents" then
  set p to path to documents folder
else if f is "applications" then

args.instructions: The text the user wants written into the new note, apart from its name.

script:

" & b & "

name: notes_open
description: Find a note in Apple Notes by its name and open it.

args.name: note_name
args.instructions: The name (or part of the name) of the note to open.

script:
set q to "{{note_name}}"
tell application "Notes"
  set found to notes whose name contains q

  set n to item 1 of found

name: notes_write
description: Write or add text to the note the user is working on in Apple Notes ('my note', 'the note', or no note named): the one open now or opened last.

args.name: text
args.instructions: The words to write into the note, without command words like 'write' or 'add'.

script:
set nid to "{{focus_id}}" set t to "{{text}}" tell application "Notes" if nid is "" then set s to selection if (count of s) is 0 then return "No note is open. Open or create one first." set n to item 1 of s else set n to note id nid end if set body of n to (body of n) & "
" & t & "
" return "Added to " & (name of n) & "." end tell
examples: add water the plants to my note
put meeting at 5 in the note
not_for: Creating a new note, or typing into apps other than Notes.

name: notes_read
description: Read aloud the note that is open (the one the user is working on) in Apple Notes.
script:
set nid to "{{focus_id}}"
tell application "Notes"
  if nid is "" then
    set s to selection
    if (count of s) is 0 then return "No note is open."
    set n to item 1 of s
  else
    set n to note id nid
  end if
  set p to plaintext of n
  if (length of p) > 400 then set p to (text 1 thru 400 of p) & "..."
  return p
end tell
